ModMetaData.name: Active Maps Framework
ModMetaData.author: 0Crystallize
ModMetaData.description:
Framework for keeping world maps loaded without a scout pawn - for long-range fire, outpost presence, and strike aftermath.
Player features: - Rimatomics Fire Mission: open / hold the target map, retarget, cease fire, end strike, short salvage window on ruins. - SitePresence outposts: stash + simulation on the world map; full map only when a raid is accepted. - Strike aftermath: salvage stash, virtual garrison, structure damage sketch, quest-aware preserve / denylist.
For mod authors (Crystallize.ActiveMaps.ActiveMapsApi): - Pin / Unpin / EnsureLoadedMap / TryUnload (foreign pins block hard unload) - Stash fold hooks, raid sketch providers, quest/site denylist, StrikeMapClass hooks
Soft Rimatomics bridge (no hard dependency). Load this mod before Rimatomics. Safe to remove when no fire mission or outpost raid is in progress.
